import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    d = p[3] + p[4]*T
    n = p[5] + p[6]*T
    return a + d*eps**n + p[7]*eps + p[8]*np.log(eps) + p[9]*eps**2
